findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM).
findings.comment: Inspector observed no certified food protection manager (CFPM) present during today’s visit. The PIC’s certification expired on 8/10/2026. The PIC has plans to take the exam at the District 186 Office. Ensure there is a CFPM present prior to the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 2-102.12(A) Certified Food Protection Manager. (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
Repeat Violation

The inspector observed the triple sink to be missing its sealant at the back of the sink. The sink needs to be sealed to the wall to prevent water and microbial accumulation. Ensure this repair is complete prior to the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: The inspector observed the triple sink to be missing its sealant at the back of the sink. The sink needs to be sealed to the wall to prevent water and microbial accumulation. The PIC was informed and stated that maintenance was performed on the sink over the summer. The PIC has plans to submit a work order for repair. Ensure this repair is complete prior to the next routine inspection.
